prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a one-storey house in a stone-and-plaster harbour town on a windy northern coast. terracotta clay tile roof in warm red-orange cream plaster walls with dark timber framing and a stone plinth. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). Flower boxes under some windows. The whole image is 240 x 192 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the ATTACHED layout guide into a single finished game-ready building sprite. Use the attached image as a strict pixel-accurate layout/mask, not merely inspiration. One-storey stone-and-plaster northern harbour house, classic 3/4 top-down JRPG perspective: broad rectangular sloping terracotta roof seen FROM ABOVE in exact original upper roof footprint, straight-on plaster front wall in exact lower wall footprint. Maintain EXACT guide's outer silhouette, roof-to-wall horizontal edge position, and EXACT positions and dimensions of BOTH amber-glowing windows and the dark brown GROUND-LEVEL walk-through door (including if toward bottom of attached guide). Do not move, resize or obscure any of these. Roof warm red-orange clay tiles, pleasing large orderly chunky pixel clusters with readable tile rows and selective worn warm-yellow highlights/purple-red recesses; gentle eaves, dark timber framing on creamy plaster wall, mottled but clean stone plinth, small-paned windows only windows luminous warm amber, restrained flower boxes under windows; optional small chimney rising into empty top margin. Do not make the roof into a front-facing gable, do not invent another entrance. Transparent alpha background replacing ALL magenta, no ground or cast shadow. Exact attached-image dimensions and alignment, a 240x192-art-pixel sprite upscaled with uniform crisp square art pixels (7x7 display pixels), hard edges, no antialiasing, blur, gradients, noise, dithering or photographic textures. Premium modern hand-placed hi-bit JRPG pixel art, 4-6 rich earthy shades per material, saturated purple/red shadows and yellow-warm highlights. Neutral even upper-left overcast evening BASE COLOR lighting, no darkness, no glowing light pools. No text, no people. Render only the single building isolated on transparency.
